text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought the injured Kiseki to the 
nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you worry. But 
really, I'm totally fine!
choice_data_list:
Just to be safe, why don't we call it a 
day and rest?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer! There's something I'd 
like to consult you about—"
choice_data_list: 念のため、今日はもう休もうか
choice_data_list_en: Just to be safe, why don't we call it a day and rest?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little! Just a bit is fine, so 
would you let me train?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I believe there are still things you can 
do even when injured... Just like Takeru 
in "Silver Diamond"!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! He's the main character from my 
favorite baseball manga!
choice_data_list: それって、漫画のキャラクターだよな？
それって、漫画のキャラクターだよね？

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even when Takeru got injured, he never 
gave up; he kept looking for ways to train 
even in that situation!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
She looked so positive and radiant...! I 
want to chase after my dreams just like 
that too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So please, Trainer! Please train me...!
choice_data_list: First, let's properly heal that injury.
If you promise it's just a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our top priority is ensuring Kiseki stays 
healthy. We can't let our guard down, even 
with the smallest injury.
choice_data_list: まずはしっかりケガを治そう
少しだけ、って約束するなら……
choice_data_list_en: First, let's make sure that injury fully heals.
If you promise it's only a little...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mrmph... Is that really what I should 
do...?
choice_data_list:
Let's put that ambition to use after you 
heal your injury!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh...! I see, using this frustration as 
a springboard, right?!
choice_data_list: その向上心は、ケガを治した後に活かそう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's put that drive to use after you've healed up!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then I need to rest up this time... so 
this injury heals as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! All right...! I've 
gotta fire myself up and do this!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please let me rest for a bit... Ugh, am I 
just not cut out for this...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her injury had worsened... It seemed like 
it would take time for a full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew...! Alright, looking good...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If it's like this, I think I can 
train little by little!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It's all thanks to 'The Silver Diamond'! 
...Oh, Trainer, would you like to read it 
with me sometime? Pretty please!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, while continuing her training, 
Kiseki aimed for a full recovery!
